local_qwen_hallucination.body:
The local speech recognition model is only producing junk right now.

This usually means the audio reaching it is noise or silence, not speech — the model itself is fine.

Check that your Windows default microphone is the one you actually speak into, and that PEER listens to the device your call or game audio really plays through (remote desktop tools and virtual audio devices are common culprits). For constant background noise like fans or air conditioning, enable Mic noise suppression in Settings.

peer_translation_eula.body:
PuriPuly captures desktop audio via loopback to translate the other person's voice.
This means it may process someone's audio without their consent, or audio from conversations you are not part of.
Depending on your region, this could violate local laws.

You are legally responsible for how you use this tool.
Whenever possible, please use it only in conversations you're actively participating in, and make sure you have the other person's consent.

PuriPuly does not store the other person's audio, transcripts, or translation results.
However, your configured external speech recognition and translation providers may process the data.

about.subtitle: A fork of PuriPuly Heart with additional features
about.fork_description: PuriPulyHeart+ is a fork of PuriPuly Heart built with gratitude to the original project. It adds optional features like transcription logging and expanded language options for users who want them. The original is wonderful and none of this would exist without it. Released under AGPL-3.0.
about.ui_design_description: Visual design (dark palette, teal accent, sidebar layout) is heavily inspired by VRCT by misyaguziya. No VRCT source code was used.
about.providers_intro: Every speech and translation back-end available in the app. Local options run on your machine with no key or cost; free-web options need no key; cloud options need an API key. Accuracy is a rough relative guide.
about.providers_footnote: “Local LLMs” connects to a model you run yourself with Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server — no key, no cost.

settings.log_api_requests.tooltip: Writes the exact content sent to translation servers (text, context, and instructions) into the program log, so you can inspect every outgoing request. Off by default.
settings.ptt_mute_sync.tooltip: Reads VRChat's current mic state directly, so Mute Sync works with push-to-talk and needs no mic toggle. Turning this ON makes Windows ask once to allow the app through the firewall (local network discovery only — nothing goes to the internet). Leave it off if you use toggle mute: syncing on your first mic toggle works as always.
settings.request_format.tooltip: The full API invoking message sent to LLM translation servers. ${model} is the selected model, ${systemPrompt} is the prompt edited above, ${text} is your spoken or typed text, ${context} is recent conversation history.
settings.request_format.helper: OpenAI-style servers (DeepSeek/OpenRouter/Qwen/Local) receive exactly this shape; Gemini carries the same content in its own field names. The <context> block is omitted without history. Free web engines (Google/Bing/Papago) and DeepL send plain text with language parameters instead.

dashboard.translit.menu.chatbox_short.to: The format of the message sent to the VRChat chatbox: original text, {system} reading, translation, or a combination.
dashboard.translit.menu.log_short.toolti: What the in-app chat log shows for each message — independent of the Chatbox format above, so you can send only the translation in game while the log keeps original, {system} and translation.
settings.separate_text_translation.toolt: OFF (default): one 'Translation' box — typed messages are sent in your partner's language (the voice 'Translate from'). If that is Auto Detect, the Text Translation box appears so you can pick the typed-output language. ON: keep a separate 'Text Translation' box with its own target. Applies immediately.
settings.auto_download_updates.tooltip: Download new versions in the background as soon as they're found, so the sidebar button only needs one press to restart and apply. Turn off to be asked before anything downloads.
settings.steamvr_autolaunch.tooltip: Automatically launch PuriPulyHeart whenever SteamVR starts, so the translator always runs alongside VRChat. SteamVR must be running when you turn this on or off.
settings.steamvr_autolaunch.steamvr_not_: SteamVR isn't running — start SteamVR, then toggle this again.
settings.steamvr_autolaunch.dev_build: Auto-start with SteamVR requires the packaged app.
settings.steamvr_autolaunch.failed: Couldn't update SteamVR auto-start. Check the logs for details.
api_view.title: API Requests
ocr_module.title: Realtime OCR module
ocr_module.body: Realtime OCR is an optional module (~150 MB download). It reads chat bubbles and world text straight off your screen. Download it now?
ocr_module.failed: The download failed. Check your connection and try again — or download PuriPulyHeartOCR-module.zip from the release page and re-run the installer with the OCR option ticked.
dashboard.ocr.menu.remove_module.tooltip: Deletes the OCR engine from disk (frees ~340 MB). You can download it again anytime by turning OCR on.
ocr_module.remove.title: Remove OCR module
ocr_module.remove.body: This deletes the Realtime OCR engine from disk (frees ~340 MB). Your OCR settings are kept. You can download it again anytime by turning OCR on. Remove it?
ocr_module.remove.done: OCR module removed — about {mb} MB freed. Turn OCR on to download it again.
settings.saved_voices.model_reset: Voice recognition was upgraded to a more accurate model, so the previously saved voices no longer apply and were cleared. Name people again from the speaker tag on a chat message.
dashboard.local_stt_notice_int8: This computer's processor cannot run the compact speech model accurately, so speech recognition may return text that reads well but is wrong. Switch speech recognition to Whisper in Settings.
dashboard.tooltip.speaker_unknown: Someone spoke here but this voice isn't saved yet — click to say who it was
dashboard.tooltip.speaker_unidentifiable: This line was too quiet or broken up to tell who was speaking
settings.overlay.edge_style.title: Character edge style
settings.overlay.edge_style.tooltip: How the edges of the caption letters are drawn. Captions sit over whatever is on screen, so an outline reads best on bright or busy scenes and a drop shadow on darker ones.
settings.overlay.text_background.title: Text background
settings.overlay.text_background.tooltip: A box drawn behind the caption letters themselves, separate from the panel behind the whole caption area. Raise it to keep text readable over bright or busy scenes without dimming everything.
stt.local.low_memory: Not enough free memory to load the local speech model — about {needed} GB needed, {available} GB free. Close other programs (games, emulators, browsers) and turn MIC on again, or pick a cloud recognizer in Settings.
settings.qwen_workspace_endpoint.hint: Paste the OpenAI-compatible URL shown above your key, e.g. https://ws-….maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 — leave empty for normal sk- keys
error.qwen_workspace_endpoint_missing: This is a workspace key (sk-ws-…). Paste your workspace endpoint from the Model Studio console into the field below, then verify again.
steam.tip_my_language: Their messages are translated into this
steam.tip_their_language: Your messages are translated into this
steam.tip_send: What your friend receives on Steam
steam.tip_show_pinyin: Reading line above originals in this chat
steam.tip_show_original: The untranslated line above the translation
steam.tip_reload: Re-fetch this chat from Steam and redraw it with the current settings. Cached translations are reused — nothing is re-billed.
steam.tip_sign_out: Disconnects this tab and clears the saved Steam login
steam.tip_module_off: Stops the Steam helper and its hidden browser so they use no RAM. Turn it back on any time from this tab.
steam.off_caption: The Steam helper and its hidden browser are not running, so this module uses no RAM.
steam.signin_caption: Signing in opens a Steam window — log in there and it closes by itself when Steam finishes loading.
steam.signout_body: This disconnects the Steam tab and clears the saved login. Signing back in opens a Steam window.
steam.retr_body: This will re-send ≈{chars} characters to your API translator (e.g. DeepL bills per character), replacing the cached translations for this chat. Tip: pick a free model (e.g. Bing) under Translator to do this at no cost.
steam.applies_new: Applies to new messages — Retranslate history converts this chat.
steam.login_waiting: Waiting for you to log in in the Steam window
settings.module.ocr_desc: Reads and translates on-screen text (~340 MB)
settings.module.steam_desc: Translated Steam friend chat in its own tab
settings.module.steam_remove_body: This deletes the Steam helper ({mb} MB) INCLUDING the saved Steam sign-in. The Steam tab disappears until the module is installed again.
settings.module.steam_installed_restart: Installed. Restart PuriPulyHeart+ to enable the Steam tab, then sign in from it.
settings.module.steam_needs_python: Installing this module needs Python installed on this PC (python.org or the Microsoft Store), because it creates its own isolated environment.
steam.not_delivered: Connection to Steam was down — your message will be sent automatically once it reconnects.
steam.redelivered: Reconnected — your queued messages were sent.
steam.idle_caption: Pick a friend from the list to start chatting. Turning the module off frees all of its RAM.
settings.module.steam_installing_runtime: Downloading a small Python runtime (~11 MB)
steam.popped_caption: Close that window — or use the button below — to bring the chat back here.
steam.power_tip: Turn the Steam module on or off
steam.too_long: Message is too long for Steam ({n}/{max})
